name: CSMIP Instrumented Buildings
about: The 61 instrumented buildings of the original ShakeReady site in one inventory: 55 from its 'Instrumented Buildings' layer and 6 from its 'Instrumented Non-Ductile Buildings' layer, compiled in 2017 from CESMD station pages and not updated since. All are stations of the California Strong Motion Instrumentation Program. Attributes in Title Case are as recorded in those layers, except that the six's number formats and one spelling were brought in line with the other 55. Attributes in lower case were added or renamed when the two were combined; see 'attributes'. Built by tools/build_csmip_buildings.py; sources, choices and checksums are at methods.html. Part of ShakeReady.

attributes.name: Station name, as recorded.
attributes.station_number: CSMIP station number, read from the address of the station page (the digits after staID=CE).
attributes.original_layer: The layer of the original ShakeReady site the building came from. The six from 'Instrumented Non-Ductile Buildings' were listed apart by the original team as non-ductile concrete. The other 55 were not classified, which is not a statement that they are ductile.
attributes.stories: The leading whole number of 'Num of Stories'. Blank where none is recorded.
attributes.design_year: The first year given in 'Design Date'. Where the text gives several dates, or a retrofit or strengthening date, read the text. Blank where none is recorded.
attributes.instrumented_year: The year at the start of 'Instrumentation'. Blank where none is given.
attributes.accelerometers: The number of accelerometers in the building: the first count in 'Instrumentation'. Sensors at free-field, ground, downhole or adjacent sites are not included.
attributes.instrumented_levels: The number of levels of the building with accelerometers, from 'Instrumentation'.
attributes.free_field: True where 'Instrumentation' mentions a free-field site, false where it does not, blank where there is no text.
